verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a REST API with OAuth2 bearer-token auth and a curl example. It can create notes, append to daily notes and manage links, so scripts or CI jobs can automate writes without the app UI. However, there is no CLI, no headless mode and no CI guidance. End-to-end encryption also means the API cannot serve note contents, which limits automation to a narrow write-mostly surface. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI usage, read access to note contents, a sandbox/test environment, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Our servers can't read the contents of your notes, so we can't serve them up in the API.
